- [Restore an archived environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/restore-an-archived-environment.md): Restor
e an archived environment. Returns 409 if another live environment took its name in the meantime. Plugin pins whose version row no
longer exists at all are dropped on the way back to live — compare the returned `pluginVersionIds` against what you archived to d
etect that. Requires `expectedRevi…
- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-projects-scenarios.md): The studies published
from this project — name, access mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.
- [Publish an environment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.
md): PUT, not POST, because publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publishing an already-published environment r
eturns the existing one rather than minting a second. `created` says which happened.
- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Del
iberately NOT behind the beta gate that guards publishing: an organization that loses the flag must still be able to take a live s
tudy down.
- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, s
ystem prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers, share link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over it
s latest analyzed window.
- [Update a scenario](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or its exposu
re — but not both in one call. **Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operations upstream, and applying th
em in sequence could leave the study live in a mode you did not ask for.
- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-scenarios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as
summaries. Project members only — this route is deliberately absent from the guest allowlist, so a share-link visitor can never re
ad other visitors' sessions.
